name: Yorick
title: Shepherd of Souls

Q.name: Last Rites
Q.description: Yorick's next Attack deals an additional 30/50/70/90/110 + 0.5×AD physical damage and restores 10+ (by level) plus 6/7/8/9/10% of his missing Health, reduced by 50% against non-Champions. If this Attack hits a Champion or large Monster or kills the target, it leaves a grave. When there are 3 or more graves nearby and this Ability has already been used, Yorick can Recast to raise Mist Walkers from all nearby graves.
Q.summary: Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug.

W.name: Dark Procession
W.description: Yorick summons a wall of spirits blocking enemies' path, but not allies'. The wall has 2/2/3/3/4 Health and disappears after 4 seconds.
W.summary: Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.

E.name: Mourning Mist
E.description: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that deals (6/6.5/7/7.5/8 + 0.03×AP) × 0.01 max Health magic damage, Slows by 0.3 for 1.5 seconds and marks champions and monsters for 4 seconds. Marked enemies continuously Awaken nearby graves (but not exceeding the maximum of @Spell.YorickPassive:YorickPassiveGhoulMax@) and suffer 13/16/19/22/25% reduced Armor. Yorick and his summoned units gain 18/21/24/27/30% Move Speed toward the mark. Mist Walkers will leap once at marked enemies that get away from them.
E.summary: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets.

R.name: Eulogy of the Isles
R.description: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist with 1050+ (by level) + 0.6×bonus max HP Health and 50/75/100 + 0.3×bonus AD Magic Attack Damage plus 2/3/4 Mist Walkers. The Maiden automatically raises Mist Walkers from nearby enemy deaths and marks enemy Champions with her attacks. When Yorick damages the Maiden's target, he deals 2/2.5/3% max Health magic damage. After 10 seconds, Yorick can Recast this Ability to free the Maiden, sending her down the nearest lane.
R.summary: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist that causes Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target to deal bonus damage. The Maiden will also automatically raise Walkers from dead enemies.

Passive.name: Shepherd of Souls
Passive.description: The Cursed Horde: Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.
Passive.summary: The Cursed Horde: Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Split-pushing top laner who raises ghouls from graves and summons the Maiden to siege. He traps enemies with his W cage and wins isolated duels.
strengths: Maiden and ghouls push towers quickly
W cage traps enemies for duels and ganks
E slows and sends ghouls at a marked champion

curve.items: strong – first bruiser item (Sundered Sky/Black Cleaver)

profile.curveNote: Trades with ghouls up and W cage.
profile.sustain: medium – Q heal on missing health
profile.mobility: low – E speed toward marked target

Q.notes: Empowered attack heals; creates graves for ghouls.

W.notes: Ring of spirits blocks enemies; break it with attacks (a few hits).

E.notes: Lobbed mist: slows, marks, ghouls chase.

profile.windowAgainst: W on cooldown: he can't trap you; trade and walk away.
